001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.log4j;
002
003import java.net.URI;
004
005import org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.LoggerContext;
006import org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.LoggerContextFactory;
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009/**
010 * Constructed directly by {@link RainbowGumLog4jProvider}'s own constructor (passed as a
011 * {@link Class} to the {@link org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider} superclass, which
012 * instantiates it reflectively via a public no-arg constructor on first use). Always
013 * returns the single {@link RainbowGumLoggerContext#INSTANCE}, since RainbowGum's
014 * {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter#global()} is itself process-global. There is no
015 * per-classloader/per-application context to separate here.
016 */
017public final class RainbowGumLoggerContextFactory implements LoggerContextFactory {
018
019        /**
020         * For reflective construction by {@link org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.Provider}.
021         */
022        public RainbowGumLoggerContextFactory() {
023        }
024
025        @Override
026        public LoggerContext getContext(String fqcn, ClassLoader loader, @Nullable Object externalContext,
027                        boolean currentContext) {
028                return RainbowGumLoggerContext.INSTANCE;
029        }
030
031        @Override
032        public LoggerContext getContext(String fqcn, ClassLoader loader, @Nullable Object externalContext,
033                        boolean currentContext, @Nullable URI configLocation, @Nullable String name) {
034                return RainbowGumLoggerContext.INSTANCE;
035        }
036
037        @Override
038        public void removeContext(LoggerContext context) {
039        }
040
041        @Override
042        public boolean isClassLoaderDependent() {
043                return false;
044        }
045
046}
